name: pam_oath
detailed_description: OATH one-time password authentication module supporting HOTP and TOTP protocols. Provides software-based OTP generation and validation. Supports RFC 4226 and RFC 4287 standards.
notes:
OATH HOTP/TOTP support (including RFC 4226/4287)
